name: 【バイブコーディング Day4】UIをプロっぽくする裏技
summary: Vibe-coding walkthrough of polishing a prototype UI with Claude Code and Tailwind CSS prompts.
description: Day 4 of a Japanese vibe-coding series. It re-designs a call-log prototype with Tailwind CSS through Claude Code prompts: unifying the color scheme, adding whitespace, drop shadows and a text-size hierarchy, with before/after button and card code plus animation touches. It also includes the prompts used and a list of reference products for picking a style.
